name: Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Lite — The Currency Convertor Plugin Helps Customers Choose their Desired Currency Exchange on the Shop, Cart, Checkout, and Other Pages
author: WPExperts

sections.description:
🔍 Live Demo | 📄 Documentation |⭐ Get Pro |

Installing the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce, a powerful currency converter plugin, can transform the functionality and impact of your e-commerce store to the next level.

This multi-currency converter plugin allows you to effortlessly change currencies on your WooCommerce sites, depending on your customers’ needs.

Currency Switcher for WooCommerce empowers current and potential customers to buy various products from anywhere worldwide.

The best thing about this plugin is its flexibility. You can integrate it anywhere on your store, product, checkout, or other page.

“Fulfill Varied Customer Bases’ Needs With Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Globally.”

Why Should B2B Businesses Configure the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Plugin? 🤔

Businesses of various sizes should integrate the Currency Converter plugin to cater to the demands of diversified target audiences.

The plugin delivers several features to WooCommerce store owners and allows them to increase their customer bases throughout the year.

They must integrate the Currency Switcher for WordPress plugin into their e-commerce stores for the following reasons:

Expand Business to multiple countries Worldwide 🌐
Currency Switcher for WooCommerce allows businesses to cater to the needs of diversified customer bases globally.

By showcasing prices to new and potential customers in familiar currencies, they can drastically expand their businesses to various countries internationally.

Results-Driven User Shopping Experience 🛒
The best thing about this Currency Converter plugin is that businesses can easily showcase prices in customers’ familiar currencies.

This creates a convenient yet results-driven shopping experience, motivating customers to complete their buying processes. Remember, satisfied customers are recurring customers, helping businesses build a consistent income stream.

Improved Customer Relationships 💼
Currency Switcher for WooCommerce enables businesses of varied sizes to develop long-term yet impactful customer relationships. Businesses can target regional and international customers by offering products in local currencies and streamlining their purchasing processes.

Increase Global Sales and Revenues 💰
Through the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce plugin, businesses can easily overcome currency conversion barriers and increase sales internationally by targeting local and foreign customers.

Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Impressive Features 🎯

Customized Currency Format 💱
Businesses can showcase currencies to existing and potential customers using currency symbols, codes, and flags through customized currency formats.

Multi-currency Support 💵
The multi-currency support feature allows businesses to display multiple currencies and simultaneously process various currencies according to customers’ locations.

Numerous Customization Options 🛠️
Various customization options help users customize the currency switcher’s appearance according to their stores’ designs.

Currency Switcher for WooCommerce User Experience Features 💻

Simple and Engaging Interface 🎨

The Currency Switcher for WooCommerce offers store owners an easy-to-use and engaging interface, allowing them to display various currencies anywhere without difficulty.

User-Friendly Display 🖼️
A customer-friendly display of multiple currencies, codes, and symbols all in one place will help store owners provide customers with an optimal user experience.

Mobile Optimization 📱
New and potential customers can use their smartphones to buy multiple products using their desired local currencies. The Currency Switcher for WooCommerce works exceptionally well on mobile devices.

Does Currency Switcher for WooCommerce have a Pro Version? 🤔
Yes, Currency Switcher for WooCommerce has a pro version, Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Pro. This results-driven plugin automatically updates exchange rates, displaying desired currencies to your potential and existing customers anywhere on websites.

What Makes the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Pro Different from Other Currency Exchange Plugins? 🚀

Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Pro offers numerous powerful features to small, medium-sized, and large e-commerce businesses:

The plugin automatically detects customers’ IP addresses and their countries through IP geolocation.
It helps businesses show all the prices based on the customers’ home currencies.

  • The plugin lets businesses incorporate widgets on the shop, cart, checkout, and other pages.
  • Businesses can smartly showcase widgets on the website’s sidebar.
    The plugin allows businesses to use a shortcode to show the currency selector widget.
  • Display on any post, page, or custom post with a shortcode;
    Businesses of various sizes can benefit from four captivating currency switcher styling options.
  • The WordPress currency switcher plugin helps businesses show currencies by language.
  • Businesses can display country flags as currency symbols.
  • Activate or deactivate multi-currency checkout.
  • The plugin is compatible with Wholesale for WooCommerce.
  • The plugin is compatible with Donation for WooCommerce.

Price by Country 🌍
This multi-currency converter plugin detects customers’ countries automatically and changes currencies accordingly. Moreover, this impressive WooCommerce plugin updates miscellaneous costs, such as product shipping, taxes, discounts, and more.

E-commerce store owners can showcase country flags as currency symbols. Likewise, the plugin helps them display currencies as country flags or names.

They can include a prefix before the currency symbol and incorporate country flags in the currency selection box.

Zone Pricing 🛒
Currency Switcher for WooCommerce allows e-commerce store owners to create and manage various pricing zones simultaneously. They can also smartly apply the zone pricing tactic to simple and variable products and cater to the needs of diversified target audiences.

Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Lite Compatibility🔌

Currency Switcher for WooCommerce lite is compatible with popular B2B plugins, Wholesale for WooCommerce, and Donation for WooCommerce.

Requirements 🛠️

  • WordPress v4.7+
  • WooCommerce 3.8+ (4.0+ recommended)
  • Currency Convert v1.5
  • PHP v5.5+ (7+ recommended)
  • How to Get Started
  • Download and install the Currency Switcher for WordPress extension. You * can find the installation guide here.
  • Activate, set up, and configure the multi-currency converter plugin.
